scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Hello~!!
Our ^009CFFScroll Publishing Company^000000
is professionally publishing
tales.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
你好~！！
我們^009CFF卷軸出版公司^000000
專業出版
故事書。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
We established
^3163FFMomotaro Field Trip^000000
to celebrate ^009CFF<Momotaro Story>^000000 selling over a million copies.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
為了慶祝^009CFF《桃太郎故事》^000000
銷量突破一百萬冊，
我們建立了
^3163FF桃太郎郊遊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Become Momotaro and eliminate
Dokebis, just like in the story!
There will also be rewards.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
化身桃太郎，
像故事裡那樣消滅土人吧！
還有獎勵哦。

scripts.text: What is Momotaro Story?
scripts.translation: 什麼是桃太郎故事？

scripts.text: I want to try!
scripts.translation: 我想試試！

scripts.text: I'm busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Eh~!? How can you not know about
Momotaro? Don't they have this
tale in Midgard?? Well...
Let me tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
誒~！？你怎麼會不知道
桃太郎呢？米德加爾特
沒有這個故事嗎？？好吧...
讓我給你講講這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Long ago, there lived an old married couple. They were happy, but didn't have any children.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
很久以前，有一對老夫妻。他們很幸福，但沒有孩子。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
One day, while old lady was doing the laundy, she found a humongous
peach. She cut it in half and...
'Poof!' There was a baby inside!
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
有一天，老婦人在洗衣服時，
發現了一個巨大的桃子。她把它切成兩半...
“噗！”裡面竟然有一個嬰兒！

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
The old man and lady were shocked.
They decided to adopt that baby,
and give him their love...
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
老人和老婦人驚呆了。
他們決定收養這個嬰兒，
並給他滿滿的愛...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
That baby grew so fast, like that beanstalk from 'Jack and Beanstalk,' and became a strong boy in only a few days.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
那個嬰兒長得飛快，就像《傑克與魔豆》裡的豆莖一樣，
幾天之內就長成了一個強壯的男孩。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
That boy's name was...
<Momotaro>!!!
Momotaro traveled to eliminate
dokebis that were harassing
the towners.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
那個男孩的名字是...
《桃太郎》！！！
桃太郎出發去消滅
騷擾鎮民的土人。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
He became friends with
^3163FFYoyo, Picky, and Desert Wolf^000000
and eliminated all of the Dokebis. Then he lived happily ever after with the old couple.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
他和
^3163FF溜溜猴、小雞和沙漠之狼^000000
成為了朋友，
並消滅了所有的土人。然後他和老夫妻幸福地生活在一起。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
How was it?
Great, right?
I mean, this story sold a million copies!
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
怎麼樣？
很棒吧？
畢竟，這個故事賣了一百萬冊呢！

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Yay-! You look excited!
You'll be ready to go soon.
Please fill out this registration card.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
耶-！你看起來很興奮！
你很快就會準備好的。
請填寫這張登記表。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
....................
......Mm.....Let's see.....
.............Good!
Alright, then!
Let it begin~~~!!!!!!!!!
<Momotaro Field Trip>~!

[Publisher]
Hmm~
Why don't you train yourself more
and come back?
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
嗯~
你為什麼不多加練習
再回來呢？

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Eh?
...But there are sweet rewards waiting...
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
誒？
...但是有甜美的獎勵在等著你呢...

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
Ah~ What nice weather!
This is the perfect weather to do some reading.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
啊~天氣真好！
這是讀書的好天氣。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
How was it? Did you have fun?
I hope you had a good time
during the field trip.
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
感覺如何？玩得開心嗎？
希望你在郊遊中度過了一段美好的時光。

scripts.text:
[Publisher]
This is your reward for you.
Please continue to enjoy stories~
scripts.translation:
[出版商]
這是給你的獎勵。
請繼續享受故事吧~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Welcome to <Momotaro Field Trip>
scripts.translation:
[聰]
歡迎來到《桃太郎郊遊》

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
I'm Satoshi who is in charge of the waiting room in <Momotaro Field Trip>.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
我是聰，負責《桃太郎郊遊》的候診室。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Originally, I was working for the publishing company, but we lacked workers for the Field Trip...
But working here is much better!
Now I just watch people trying to accomplish the mission. Heh hehe~
scripts.translation:
[聰]
原本我在出版社工作，但郊遊活動人手不足...
不過在這裡工作好多了！
我現在只需要看著大家努力完成任務。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
................
Just kidding
*Wipes away sweat*

[Satoshi]
Well, let me explain
about the rules in the Field Trip.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
那麼，讓我來解釋一下郊遊的規則。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
First of all...Did you hear
about the story from the publisher?
scripts.translation:
[聰]
首先...你聽到出版商講的故事了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Hehe...Good.
Momotaro Story is our
pride. It's the best story EVER.
Hahahah!!!
scripts.translation:
[聰]
嘿嘿...很好。
桃太郎的故事是我們的驕傲。這是有史以來最好的故事。
哈哈哈!!!

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
...Hmmhmm.

[Satoshi]
The Field Trip is simple.
Go inside and eliminate
Dokebis bravely!!!
Just like Momotaro!!!
Understand? Bravely!!!
scripts.translation:
[聰]
郊遊很簡單。
進去勇敢地消滅土人!!!
就像桃太郎一樣!!!
明白了嗎？要勇敢!!!

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
In addition, there are three
things you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
此外，有三件事你需要知道。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
First....
You can't come back once you clear the field trip. Keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
第一....
一旦完成郊遊，你就不能回來了。請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Secondly....
Q-pet is prohibited
inside of the field trip.
If you are with a pet,
please change it to egg status.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
第二....
郊遊內部禁止攜帶Q版寵物。
如果你帶著寵物，請將其變為蛋的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
And finally...
One person can be on the
field trip for 6 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
最後...
每個人在郊遊中的時間為6分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Well then, please
wait your turn
in the waiting room.
Good luck in fighting!!
scripts.translation:
[聰]
那麼，請在候診室等待你的回合。
祝你戰鬥順利!!

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Eh? You can't just
skip the story
when you enter field trip!!
I can't allow you to do that
as Momotaro's fan!!!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
誒？進入郊遊時不能跳過故事!!
作為桃太郎的粉絲，我不能允許你這樣做!!!

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Please listen to the story
from the publisher.
Thank you.
Bye~~
scripts.translation:
[助手]
請聽出版商講的故事。
謝謝。
再見~~

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Oh my...Are you alright?
I thought it was entertaining but maybe it was too hard for you?
scripts.translation:
[聰]
天哪...你沒事吧？
我覺得這很有趣，但也許對你來說太難了？

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Now what are you going to do?
Do you want to go in again?
scripts.translation:
[聰]
現在你打算怎麼辦？
你想再進去一次嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, I want to go back
scripts.translation: 不，我想回去

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
The more effort you put into this, the sweeter victory will taste.
Good luck in fighting!
scripts.translation:
[聰]
你付出的努力越多，勝利的滋味就越甜美。
祝你戰鬥順利！

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Well, I guess the reality of the situation is that you just can't fulfill the role of Momotaro...
Still, don't be depressed.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
看來現實情況是，你無法勝任桃太郎的角色...
不過，別灰心。

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
I think you've gained enough experience from the field trip.
scripts.translation:
[聰]
我想你在郊遊中已經獲得了足夠的經驗。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[助手]
如果您聽到好故事，
請聯絡我們的
出版公司。
再見-

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Woohoo~ Congratulations!!
You were so great!
scripts.translation:
[聰]
哇哦~恭喜！！
你太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
It is time to say good bye.
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[聰]
是時候說再見了。
如果您聽到好故事，
請聯絡我們的
出版公司。
再見-

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
Woohoo~ Congratulations!!
You were so great!!
Even though your finish was kind of weak...
scripts.translation:
[聰]
哇哦~恭喜！！
你太棒了！！
雖然你的結局有點弱...

scripts.text:
[Satoshi]
It is time to say good bye.
If you hear a good story,
Please, contact our
publishing company.
Bye-
scripts.translation:
[聰]
是時候說再見了。
如果您聽到好故事，
請聯絡我們的
出版公司。
再見-

[Hanako chan]

[Grandma]
Arrrk!!!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
啊啊啊!!!

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Honey!! Someone hacked my account and stole my equipment!!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
親愛的!!有人黑了我的賬號，偷走了我的裝備!!

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
Hmm. The Chief said Dokebi earned 20 million zeny by hacking others' accounts...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
嗯。首領說土人通過黑別人的賬號賺了2000萬Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Dohhhhhhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
嗚嗚嗚嗚!!!!

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
....Huh I've heard that somewhere.. .....
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
....嗯，我在哪裡聽說過... .....

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
Anyway, Momotaro...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
總之，桃太郎...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa]
As you know, since we towners spend our time sitting and chatting,
we can't kill Dokebis because we're low level, so...Please do it for us.
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
你知道的，因為我們鎮民整天坐著聊天，
等級太低殺不了土人，所以...請替我們做吧。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Momotaro...
I really wanted to give you
a handmade ^3163FFYummiest Red Potion in the whole world^000000 ...but...
.....I failed to make them ....
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
桃太郎...
我真的很想給你
親手做的^3163FF世界上最美味的紅色藥水^000000 ...但是...
.....我沒能做出來 ....

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
...I'm sorry. I should have been leveling up before...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
...對不起。我應該先升級的...*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Grandma & Grandpa]
So...Do me this favor, kid~
scripts.translation:
[爺爺奶奶]
那麼...拜託你了，小孩~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hoho~ Good.
I've been watching you in the VIP room. You were really something.
I was truly amazed.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
呵呵~ 很好。
我一直在VIP室觀察你。你真的很厲害。
我真是驚歎不已。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
I thought you were really
Momotaro in the story!
Hohohoho...
scripts.translation:
[教練]
我覺得你簡直就是
故事裡的桃太郎！
呵呵呵...

scripts.text: Well, well. It is nothing~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，沒什麼~

scripts.text: It was boring.
scripts.translation: 很無聊。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
...Hohoho..
Don't be so proud of yourself.
When I was young like you,
I squashed Dokebi with
my little finger. Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[教練]
...呵呵呵..
別太得意了。
像我像你這麼大的時候，
我用小拇指就能捏死土人。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
..............
...Don't give me that look.
I was just joking. Hmmhmm.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
..............
...別用那種眼神看我。
我只是在開玩笑。嗯嗯。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Now, the Momotaro story is over.
You can get your reward when you talk to the Publisher lady you saw first.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
好了，桃太郎的故事結束了。
你可以去找你一開始遇到的那位出版商女士領取獎勵了。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Don't lose your high self-esteem
in the future. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
以後不要失去你的高自尊。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
.....!!!!!!
....Hohohoho..
You're pretty funny.
Alright, hot stuff.
Do you want to listen to my proposal?
scripts.translation:
[教練]
.....!!!!!!
....呵呵呵..
你還挺有趣的。
好吧，厲害的角色。
你想聽聽我的提議嗎？

scripts.text:
[Coach]
At this point I'm supposed to send you back...BUT!
I really want to know
what you are capable of. Hehe~
Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[教練]
按理說我現在應該把你送回去了...但是！
我真的想知道
你的極限在哪裡。嘿嘿~
呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Coach]
So, I will give you a chance.
But if you fail,
^3163FFyou can't take this challenge.^000000
Also, this mission will be pretty hard.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
所以，我會給你一個機會。
但是如果你失敗了，
^3163FF你就不能再接受這個挑戰了。^000000
另外，這個任務會相當困難。

scripts.text: Nah.. I'm good.
scripts.translation: 不...我沒事。

scripts.text: Bring it on, foo'!
scripts.translation: 放馬過來吧，老傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hoho~I understand...
You must be exhausted from the previous battle. It would have been a grand battle, though...
scripts.translation:
[教練]
呵呵~ 我明白了...
你肯定是被之前的戰鬥累壞了。不過那確實是一場精彩的戰鬥...

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Now, the Momotaro story is over.
You can get your reward
when you talk to
the Publisher lady you first spoke to.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
好了，桃太郎的故事結束了。
你可以去找你一開始交談的那位出版商女士
領取獎勵了。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Don't lose your high self-esteem
in the future. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
以後不要失去你的高自尊。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hohoho~ I like your attitude.
Now, this is the last battle!
Show me what you got.
I'm looking forward to this.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
呵呵呵~ 我喜歡你的態度。
現在，這是最後一戰！
讓我看看你的實力。
我很期待。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Boom bam Boooom!!!
Tada~~~ !
scripts.translation:
[教練]
轟隆 轟隆 轟隆！！！
太棒了~~~！

scripts.text:
[Coach]
( Clap- Clap- Clap- )
scripts.translation:
[教練]
( 鼓掌- 鼓掌- 鼓掌- )

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Hohoho~ You are really something.
You've got the moves, kiddo.
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[教練]
呵呵呵~ 你真的很厲害。
你身手不錯，小鬼。
我承認這一點。

scripts.text:
[Coach]
Well, time's up so...
Let me show you the exit.
I had a great time...
Don't forget to get your reward~
scripts.translation:
[教練]
時間到了，所以...
讓我帶你去出口吧。
和你在一起很開心...
記得去領取你的獎勵哦~

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Hey. You look really heavy.
Don't you have trouble walking?
I'm sorry, but there is no space
to put down your stuff in my shop.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
嘿。你看起來好重啊。
走路不費勁嗎？
抱歉，我的店裡沒有空間讓你放下這些東西。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Put some of your stuff away somewhere.
Why are you carrying so much...?
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
把一些東西收起來吧。
你為什麼背了這麼多東西...？
呼呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Training to slice raw fish
daily will make you a master sushi chef.
So don't waste your time in here, and learn what you are good at.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
每天練習切生魚片，你就能成為壽司大師。
所以不要在這裡浪費時間，去學你擅長的東西吧。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I really need them to make a dessert.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哦！非常感謝。
準時到了！
我正好需要它們來做甜點。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks. It's nothing, but
I will give you my shop's special cuisine, Fish Slice, in return.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
謝謝。雖然不值什麼，
但我會用我店裡的特色料理——生魚片作為回報。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Here's 15 fish slices.
Please enjoy this food with your friends.
And come back whenever you miss the flavor of Amatsu cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
這是15份生魚片。
請和朋友一起享用。
如果想念櫻花城料理的味道，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh man, you didn't prepare
what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哎呀，你沒準備我要求的東西...
別忘了我讓你帶什麼。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
10 ^0000FFCandy^000000
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me these supplies, please.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
10個 ^0000FF糖果^000000
你沒忘吧？
請把這些材料帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Oh! I really appreciate it.
Right on time!
I need them to make a sauce.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哦！非常感謝。
準時到了！
我正好需要它們來做醬汁。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks. It is nothing, but
I will give you two sets of Sushi in return.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
謝謝。雖然不值什麼，
但我會用兩份壽司作為回報。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need a white platter:
1 ^0000FFChina^000000
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring it to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我需要白色的盤子：
1個 ^0000FF瓷器^000000
你沒忘吧？
記得帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
You are a really kind person.
You have brought everything
that I've asked you...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
你真是個善良的人。
你把我要求的東西都帶來了...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
You are not the first foreigner
I have encountered. Amatsu is getting more and more tourists.
I just wanted to test you.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
你不是我遇到的第一個外地人。櫻花城來的遊客越來越多了。
我只是想考驗一下你。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Your job was just errands but
I wanted to know...
how you devote yourself,
how serious you are about completing your job and not giving up.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
你的任務只是跑腿，
但我想看看...
你有多投入，
你對待完成任務有多認真，是否會半途而廢。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I was thinking,
'If there is a person like that,
I would give that person everything about cooking that I have mastered
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我在想，
“如果有這樣一個人，
我會把我掌握的烹飪技藝全都傳授給他。”

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
And.....
You...
You are the one.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
而且.....
你...
你就是那個人。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I'm old now. No one knows how long I can hold this knife. You have been chosen to inherit my culinary art...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我年紀大了。沒人知道這把刀還能在我手中握多久。你被選中繼承我的烹飪技藝了...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Here, take my knife.
From now on, make fine cuisine with that knife.
...Learn how to slice a fish.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
拿著，這是我的刀。
從今往後，用這把刀做出精美的料理吧。
...學習如何切魚。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
From now on, I will no longer ask you favors and give you fish slices in return....
Practice your skill with that knife and teach mainlanders the pleasure of fine cuisine...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
從今往後，我不再讓你跑腿，也不再用魚片回報你....
用這把刀磨練技藝，讓大陸人體驗精緻料理的樂趣吧...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Wow...these are real hearts of
mermaid. The legends saying
that these could be found in another continent were true...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哇...這些是真正的美人魚之心。傳說在另一個大陸能找到的說法是真的...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Gathering all these must have been hard...Well, then.
Today, I will use all of my
ingredients to make a special cuisine for you!
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
收集這些一定很不容易...好了，那麼。
今天，我會用我所有的食材為你做一道特別的料理！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Give me a moment...
I shall show you my ^0000FFtrue culinary skill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
請稍等...
我要向你展示我的 ^0000FF真正廚藝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Try these first.
Made from the freshest ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
先嚐嘗這個。
用的是最新鮮的食材。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Try these too.
My shop's fish slices are the best of the best!
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
也嚐嚐這個。
我店裡的魚片是最好中的最好！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Have some more. Don't say no...!
Isn't it good? Huh? Isn't it good?
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
再吃點。別拒絕...！
好吃嗎？嗯？好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha~! Not done yet!
It's okay, have some more!
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哈哈~！還沒完呢！
沒關係，再吃點！

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Take the leftovers.
You look stuffed...
Share the rest with your friends and family.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
剩下的你帶走吧。
看你都吃撐了...
把剩下的分給你的朋友和家人吧。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Thanks a lot for today! Haha!
Come back again when you feel like helping. Take care...!!!
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
今天多謝惠顧！哈哈！
想幫忙的時候再來吧。保重...!!!

scripts.text:

what I asked for...
Do not forget what I asked.
scripts.translation:

哎呀，你沒準備我要求的東西...
別忘了我讓你帶什麼。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
100 ^0000FFHearts of Mermaid^000000, okay?
You didn't forget it, right?
Bring me the supplies, please.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
100個 ^0000FF美人魚之心^000000，好嗎？
你沒忘吧？
請幫我帶這些材料來。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Holy cow~
This is a problem.....
There are so many customers, but I can't get all the ingredients that I need...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
天哪~
這下麻煩了.....
顧客這麼多，但我沒法買到所有需要的食材...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
This is horrible...
Some of my customers will not get
the chance to eat fine Amatsu cuisine...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
太糟糕了...
有些顧客將沒有機會品嚐到
美味的櫻花城料理...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Well, well. Are you a customer?
Welcome. As always, my shop
highly values the freshness of
fish slices. What brings you down here...?
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哎呀，您是顧客嗎？
歡迎光臨。一如既往，
本店非常注重魚片的新鮮度。
您來這裡是有什麼事嗎...？

scripts.text: I would like to buy Sushi
scripts.translation: 我想買壽司

scripts.text: I would like to buy fish slice
scripts.translation: 我想買魚片

scripts.text: Do you need assistance?
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Keep up the good work
scripts.translation: 請繼續加油

scripts.text:

A set of Sushi is 700z. If you
want just 1 Sushi. It is 74z.
If you want more, tell me.
scripts.translation:

好的...！要多少？
一套壽司是700z。如果只想要1個壽司，是74z。
如果要多，請告訴我。

scripts.text: 700z A set!
scripts.translation: 700z 一套！

scripts.text: 74z A piece!
scripts.translation: 74z 一個！

scripts.text: I will try it later

If you want to eat delicious fish slices, you better bring more money.
scripts.translation:

哎呀，您的Zeny不夠。
如果想吃美味的魚片，最好多帶點錢。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
There you go. If you like the taste, please order some more.
scripts.translation:

給您。如果味道不錯，請再點一些。

and freshness are the best in the
world. If you have time, try my Sushi.

是最好中的最好！味道
和新鮮度都是世界一流的。
如果有時間，請嚐嚐我的壽司。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha~ YOU are the one who needs
assistance! Help others
when you can take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哈哈~ 需要幫助的是你吧！
能照顧好自己時，
也要幫助別人。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Some help would be great~!!
I was worried because we always
run out of ingredients...
Will you do me a favor?
I will reward you.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
如果能幫上忙就太好了~！！
我一直擔心食材總是用完...
能幫我個忙嗎？
我會給你報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need some candies to make
a dessert for the customers.
Bring me ^0000FF10 Candy^000000.
It's not hard, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我需要一些糖果來給顧客做甜點。
請給我^0000FF10糖果^000000。
這不難吧？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I need some crab shells to make
a sauce for my cuisine...
If you bring me ^0000FF10 Crab Shells^000000,
I will reward you.
Okay?
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我需要一些螃蟹外殼來做醬汁...
如果你給我^0000FF10螃蟹外殼^000000，
我會給你報酬。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
I have used all of my conches.
I need it to make an appetizer...
Please bring me ^0000FF10 Conches^000000.
It is hard to find conches around here...
Please do me this favor.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我的海螺都用完了。
我需要它來做開胃菜...
請給我^0000FF10海螺^000000。
這裡很難找到海螺...
請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Decorative fish tails are out of
stock. This is urgent...
Please bring me ^0000FF10 fish tails^000000.
They are always missing when I need them badly...
Please do me this favor.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
裝飾用的魚尾缺貨了。這很緊急...
請給我^0000FF10魚尾^000000。
每次我急需的時候它們總是缺失...
請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
We are missing a platter to serve
fish slices to customers.
This is horrible...
Will you buy me some fine porcelain ^0000FFChina^000000?
I can't just put food anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我們缺少用來給顧客上魚片的盤子。
這太糟糕了...
你能幫我買一些精美的^0000FF瓷器^000000嗎？
我不能隨便把食物放在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Don't ask me why...
But, I need something special...
^0000FF100 Hearts of Mermaid^000000.....
I know that it sounds impossible, but it is really important to me...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
別問我為什麼...
但我需要一些特別的東西...
^0000FF100美人魚之心^000000.....
我知道這聽起來不可能，但這對我真的很重要...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Don't ask any questions
about my request...
Just keep what I want in mind.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
別問關於我要求的問題...
只要記住我想要的東西。

scripts.text:

fish slices to customers.
This is horrible...
Will you buy me some fine porcelain ^0000FFChina^000000? I can't just put food anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
我們缺少用來給顧客上魚片的盤子。
這太糟糕了...
你能幫我買一些精美的^0000FF瓷器^000000嗎？我不能隨便把食物放在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Well, good luck to you...
I will be waiting for you.
Don't forget what I asked...
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
好吧，祝你好運...
我會等著你的。
別忘了我讓你帶的東西...

scripts.text:
[Magumagu]
Haha, you won't forget the flavor of my fish slice once you've
tasted it. If you have time, try my fish slices.
scripts.translation:
[馬古馬古]
哈哈，一旦你嘗過我的魚片，就不會忘記那個味道。
如果有時間，請嚐嚐我的魚片。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
This is the great palace,
Toukoujyo.
Locals are prohibited
from entering...
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
這裡是偉大的宮殿，
東宮城。
當地人禁止入內...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Your attire looks unfamiliar.
Are you from another continent?
The lord has granted entrance to
tourists, so you can go in.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
你的穿著看起來很陌生。
你是來自其他大陸的嗎？
領主允許遊客進入，所以你可以進去。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Are you from Midgard?
Welcome to Amatsu.
Visit our lord in Chun-Su-Gak
when you go in.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
你是來自米德加爾特嗎？
歡迎來到櫻花城。
進去後請去春壽閣拜訪我們的領主。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
He is really kind.
He invested in various fields for
Amatsu, and intercontinental trade was his idea.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
他真的很仁慈。
他為櫻花城投資了各個領域，
洲際貿易也是他的主意。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Welcome. The lord of the palace
has specially allowed guests
from other continents.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
歡迎。宮殿的領主
特別允許來自其他大陸的
客人進入。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Look around and take your time.
Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
請隨意參觀，慢慢欣賞。
祝您在此度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The lord is really nice guy.
Who would know that our town was
once a small village?
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
領主真的是個好人。
誰能想到我們這座城鎮曾經只是一個小小的村莊呢？

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
I thank him for hiring me.
These days, he seems to have
troubles on his mind.
Lately, he's been looking pretty gloomy.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
我很感激他僱用了我。
最近，他似乎有心事。
看起來有些鬱鬱寡歡。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
You can't enter here.
The mother of our lord is resting in here. She needs her rest.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
你不能進去。
領主的母親正在裡面休息，她需要靜養。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She should regain her health...
But still, my lord is worrying so much.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
她應該會恢復健康的...
但即便如此，領主還是很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Augh! I was suprised by that loud sound.
What happened? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
啊！我被那巨大的聲響嚇了一跳。
發生什麼事了？什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The mother of our lord hasn't
fully recovered her health.
Still, she is better than before.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
領主的母親還沒有完全康復。
不過，她比之前好多了。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
If you are sent by my lord,
it is okay to enter...
But you wouldn't be able to cure
her. Many others tried and failed.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
如果你是受領主派遣來的，
可以進去...
但你無法治癒她。很多人都試過，但都失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She has been sick for months.
That is why she is staying in here.
It's a pretty fearsome sickness...
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
她已經病了幾個月了。
所以她一直待在這裡。
這是一種相當可怕的病...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
You can't enter here.
The mother of our lord is resting in here.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
你不能進去。
領主的母親正在裡面休息。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Please, be quiet.
The mother of the lord is staying in here. She needs to relax.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
請保持安靜。
領主的母親正在裡面休養，她需要放鬆。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Eh? Something was flying
in the sky... You didn't see? Ugh.
That sound suprised me.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
咦？剛才好像有什麼東西在天上飛過...
你沒看到嗎？唉。
那聲音嚇了我一跳。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Now our lord is relieved.
We were so worrying about it so much.
Now, it is okay... *sob*.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
現在領主放心了。
我們之前真的很擔心。
現在沒事了... *抽泣*。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Oh...man. People from the other
continents are all doctors!
How many doctors have come to visit?! I can't even count anymore!
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
哦...天哪。來自其他大陸的人都是醫生嗎？
有多少醫生來拜訪過？我都數不清了！

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
She has been sick for months.
That is why she is staying in here.
...
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
她已經病了幾個月了。
所以她一直待在這裡。
...

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
Why is this happening
to my kind lord...
How can it be? *Sob*...
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
為什麼這種事會發生在仁慈的領主身上...
怎麼會這樣？*抽泣*...

scripts.text:
[Ichiro]
Welcome.
Our lord prepared guest rooms
for travelers like you.
scripts.translation:
[一郎]
歡迎。
領主為像您這樣的旅行者準備了客房。

scripts.text:
[Ichiro]
If you are having any problems,
tell me. I would appreciate it if you talk to our lord of the
palace. This is all provided by him.
scripts.translation:
[一郎]
如果您有任何問題，請告訴我。
如果您願意，可以和宮殿的領主談談。這些都是他提供的。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
I'm Jiro, the administrator
of this Palace. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
我是次郎，這座宮殿的管理員。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Issue me a Transit Permit
scripts.translation: 給我一張中轉通行證

scripts.text: I want to live in Amatsu
scripts.translation: 我想住在櫻花城

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
You already have one...
You don't need to have two of them.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
您已經有一張了...
不需要兩張。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Did you lose your Transit Permit?
You need to pay 10,000 zeny as a tax
to issue another Transit Permit.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
您的中轉通行證丟了嗎？
需要支付10,000 Zeny的稅費
才能補辦一張中轉通行證。

scripts.text: Issue one
scripts.translation: 補辦一張

scripts.text: Talk to you later
scripts.translation: 稍後再聊

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
There you go.
Don't lose it this time.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
給您。
這次可別再弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Okay, then...
Talk to me when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
好的，那麼...
有需要幫助時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gate Soldier]
The lord announced that
he grants guests from Midgard the right to go anywhere.
You don't need me to issue you a Transit Permit.
scripts.translation:
[城門士兵]
領主宣佈，
允許來自米德加爾特的客人自由前往任何地方。
您不需要我為您辦理中轉通行證。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
That is impossible. You're free to
go anywhere in Amatsu, but my lord doesn't want to concern himself with immigration.
Instead of that, you can stay here as long as you want.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
這不可能。您在櫻花城可以自由前往任何地方，但領主不想介入移民事務。
相反，您可以想住多久就住多久。

scripts.text:
[Jiro]
Well then...
Talk to me when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[次郎]
那麼...
有需要幫助時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
This is the training ground for improving our battle skills.
Please look around...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
這裡是提升戰鬥技巧的訓練場。
請隨意參觀...

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
By the way, recently I've felt
like the soldiers have changed
lately. How do I say it...
Their faces are gloomy and
some of them are no longer around.
Have they gone to Midgard??
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
順便說一句，最近我感覺
士兵們有些變化。該怎麼說呢...
他們神情憂鬱，
有些人也不見了蹤影。
他們去米德加爾特了嗎？？

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
In this job, I encounter
many strangers. But downstairs,
there's a guest from a distant land who seems suspicious...
I told my guards to watch him...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
在這個職位上，我會遇到
許多陌生人。但在樓下，
有一位來自遠方的客人看起來很可疑...
我讓衛兵監視他...

scripts.text:
[Saburo]
Of course, my lord precisely knows everything that's going on.
Haha, don't take what I said seriously~
See ya...
scripts.translation:
[三郎]
當然，領主對發生的一切瞭如指掌。
哈哈，別太當真~
再見...

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
*Cough, Cough* What...
Don't talk to me...
*Cough, Cough*... Oh, my freakin' neck.
scripts.translation:
[白]
*咳嗽，咳嗽* 什...
別跟我說話...
*咳嗽，咳嗽*... 噢，我的脖子真難受。

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
That quack's cold medicine
is useless! I should never have trusted people from Midgard!
*Cough, Cough*...
scripts.translation:
[白]
那個庸醫開的感冒藥
一點用都沒有！我早該知道不能相信米德加爾特的人！
*咳嗽，咳嗽*...

scripts.text:
[Shiro]
I don't know why but...
I'm getting worse and worse...
What kind of cold is this?
*Cough*... *Cough*...
scripts.translation:
[白]
我不知道為什麼...
我的病情越來越嚴重了...
這是什麼感冒？
*咳嗽*... *咳嗽*...

scripts.text:
[Goro]
*Psst*... Please, be quiet.
I will tell you a story, okay?
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
*噓*... 請小聲點。
我要給你講個故事，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goro]
There is a rumor in Amatsu.
The lord of this palace isn't
real... *Psst*, Quiet!
Don't panic and listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
櫻花城有個傳聞。
這座宮殿的領主
不是真的... *噓*，小聲點！
別驚慌，聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Goro]
There is a real lord behind
the kind lord and he is scheming
something. He is controlling
our town in some hidden place.
...Our kind lord is just a figurehead~!
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
在仁慈的領主背後
還有另一位真正的領主，他正在
策劃著什麼。他在某個隱秘的地方
控制著我們的城鎮。
...我們仁慈的領主只是個傀儡~！

scripts.text:
[Goro]
It's for real! Trust me~
I saw him. The lord who was
laughing at the town on the
TenguGak!!
Just don't tell anyone that I've told you this, okay?
scripts.translation:
[五郎]
千真萬確！相信我~
我親眼見過他。就是那個在天狗閣上
嘲笑我們城鎮的領主！！
拜託，千萬別告訴別人我跟你說了這些，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
He always talks nonsense.
He says that our lord
is not real, but a fake.
It's not even funny.
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
他總是在胡說八道。
他說我們的領主
不是真的，而是假的。
這根本不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
However, it is true that
recently, weird things are
happening. There were no
prohibited places before...
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
不過，最近確實發生了一些
奇怪的事情。以前這裡
並沒有禁止進入的地方...

scripts.text:
[Rokuro]
I hear strange sounds sometimes.
The mother of the lord has been
visited by doctors several times.
I guess her health hasn't
improve after their visits...
scripts.translation:
[六郎]
我有時能聽到奇怪的聲音。
領主的母親
最近被醫生探望了好幾次。
我想她的健康狀況
並沒有好轉...

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
Have a good time.
My lord prepared some
guest rooms.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
祝您玩得愉快。
領主大人為您準備了
客房。

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
If you have any problems,
please call me. Also, try not to disturb the other guests.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
如果您有任何問題，
請隨時叫我。另外，請儘量不要打擾其他客人。

scripts.text:
[Shichiro]
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[七郎]
祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hachiro]
My lord is inside.
If you'd like to greet him, feel free to enter.
scripts.translation:
[八郎]
領主大人在裡面。
如果您想向他致意，請隨意進入。

scripts.text:
[Hachiro]
Don't be rude in front of him.
He is somehow not feeling well.
Usually, he greets people from
other continents gladly, but...
What could have happened to him...?
scripts.translation:
[八郎]
在他面前不要無禮。
他最近身體不太舒服。
通常，他會很高興地接待
來自其他大陸的人，但是...
他到底發生了什麼事...？

scripts.text:
[Kyuro]
This is not good.
My lord is really kind, but
recently he is not doing well...
scripts.translation:
[九郎]
情況不妙。
領主大人非常仁慈，但
最近他狀態不太好...

scripts.text:
[Kyuro]
I've heard about the rumors
but I trust him. He made
Amatsu into a great town.
That is why I'm following
him as a soldier.
scripts.translation:
[九郎]
我聽說過那些傳聞，
但我信任他。他把櫻花城
建設成了一個偉大的城鎮。
這就是我作為士兵
追隨他的原因。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What are you doing in here?
There is nothing interesting here.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你在這裡做什麼？
這裡沒什麼有趣的。

scripts.text: That is true
scripts.translation: 確實如此

scripts.text: Open the gate
scripts.translation: 開啟大門

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are much better things to enjoy in town. Have a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城鎮裡有更值得享受的事物。祝您玩得愉快...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
You have the ticket...
Do you want me to send you now, or do you need a little instruction?
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你有門票...
你想讓我現在送你進去，還是需要一點說明？

scripts.text: I will go in
scripts.translation: 我要進去

scripts.text: Instruction, please
scripts.translation: 請給我說明

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I will open the gate.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我會開啟大門。
請保重...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
The area beyond this gate is
protected by some kind of magic.
You may get killed by someone
or get lost.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
這道門後面的區域
受到某種魔法的保護。
你可能會被人殺死
或者迷路。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I can't tell you much.
I didn't go far inside and
and just took a quick look.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我沒法告訴你太多。
我沒有深入內部，
只是匆匆看了一眼。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
First.....
'Do not trust what you are
seeing.' I don't know what
it means, but I guess you shouldn't believe everything before your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
第一.....
“不要相信你所看到的。”
我不知道這具體是什麼意思，
但我想你不應該相信眼前的一切。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Second.....
'There are certain rules in
magic.' Everything has a
reason to exist. Magic is not an exception. You can probably find the answer...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
第二.....
“魔法有其特定的規則。”
萬物的存在都有其理由，
魔法也不例外。
你大概能找到答案...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Well, I will open this gate.
Take care of yourself...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
好了，我會開啟這道門。
請保重...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I'm sorry.
You need a Transit Permit to go in.
Please, go back.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
很抱歉。
你需要中轉許可證才能進去。
請回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What gate are you talking about?
A gate? On the top floor of the building??? Surely, you must been be mistaken.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你在說什麼門？
門？在建築物的頂層？？？
你肯定是搞錯了。

scripts.text: Show him the ticket
scripts.translation: 出示門票

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
What? That pass is...?
That Transit Permit is from
the lord but I guess it has
been issued to the wrong person.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
什麼？那張通行證是...？
那張中轉許可證是領主簽發的，
但我猜它發錯人了。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
I will keep this ticket because
it was issued without permission.
This is a warning.
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
我會沒收這張門票，
因為它是未經授權的。
這是一個警告。
小心點。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are more things to enjoy in town. Have a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城鎮裡還有更多值得享受的事物。
祝你玩得開心...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
There are more things to enjoy in town. Have yourself a good time...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
城鎮裡還有更多值得享受的事物。
祝你盡興...

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
你想回去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do
scripts.translation: 是的，我想

scripts.text: I will stay here
scripts.translation: 我要留在這裡

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
請保重。

scripts.text:
[Jyuro]
Take care...
scripts.translation:
[十郎]
保重...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
What! A foreigner...? *Phew*
I'm sorry, but I'm not in
the mood to meet new people!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
什麼！是外國人...？*呼*
很抱歉，我現在沒心情見新人！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Get out! I'm not interested
in who you are.
I'm not feeling well!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
出去！我不關心你是誰。
我不舒服！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
What! A foreigner? What brings
you here? If it is not urgent,
come to me another time...!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
什麼！是外國人？什麼事把你帶到這裡？
如果不緊急，改天再來找我...！

scripts.text: I heard about your mother...
scripts.translation: 我聽說你母親的事...

scripts.text: Your last name is nice
scripts.translation: 你的姓氏很好聽

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Oh...So you know about her disease?
I've heard that, in foreign lands,
the body of medical knowledge can
be quite amazing.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
哦...原來你知道她的病情？
我聽說，在外國，
醫學知識非常淵博。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Welcome. As you know, I'm the
lord of Toukoujyo,
Ishida Yoshinaga. Nice to
meet you.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
歡迎。如你所知，我是唐國城的城主，
石田 義永。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Let's get to the point.
My mother is not doing well recently. I know you are here because of that.
Can you cure her disease?
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
我們直入正題吧。
我母親最近身體不好。我知道你是為此而來的。
你能治好她的病嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Until now, many famous doctors
have visited her, but they
all failed to cure her disease
and made it worse...
They disappointed me.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
到目前為止，許多名醫
都曾來探望過她，但他們
都未能治好她的病，反而使病情加重了...
他們讓我很失望。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
You, who hail from Midgard,
may be able to cure my mother's disease. I will reward you well if you succeed...
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
你來自米德加爾特，
也許能治好我母親的病。如果你成功了，我會重重賞賜你...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
I beg you...Please.
My mother is living in a house outside of the palace.
Come to me when you finish your treatment.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
拜託了...求你了。
我母親住在宮殿外面的一棟房子裡。
治療結束後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Nice!? So What?!
Read my name until you get
tired of it! Darn it!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
好聽？！那又怎樣？！
把我的名字讀到你讀膩為止！該死的！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Joking, even in this critical situation... *Phew*...
Please have a good time in Amatsu.
...Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
在這種緊要關頭還開玩笑... *呼*...
祝你在櫻花城玩得愉快。
...隨便吧！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
...me? Don't you know? Huh?
I'm the lord of this palace.
If you don't know, talk to
the soldiers outside!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
...我？你不知道嗎？哼？
我是這座宮殿的城主。
如果你不知道，去問問外面計程車兵！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
I've heard the great news!
My mother seems to have gotten better. What was her disease?
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
我聽到了好訊息！
我母親似乎好轉了。她得的是什麼病？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
A fox? Is that so? Oh...
It wasn't a disease...!!
Why didn't I notice?!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
狐狸？是嗎？哦...
原來不是病...！！
我為什麼沒有發現？！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Darn fox. To run away and
take revenge on me in such a
way...Well, then. There's no chance of revenge now... Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
該死的狐狸。竟然跑掉，
還用這種方式報復我...好吧。現在沒有報復的機會了... 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Hmm, Mmm. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
嗯，嗯。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Anyway, thank you for helping me.
Mother will be okay now...
I want to reward you...
But what would be nice...?
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
總之，謝謝你幫了我。
母親現在沒事了...
我想賞賜你...
但是給什麼好呢...？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Alright, I will give you
a Transit Permit.
You can go anywhere
with this ticket.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
好吧，我會給你
一張中轉通行證。
憑這張票你可以去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
This isn't a big reward but
someday it will be useful for you.
Ask my soldier, 'Jyuro' about the details.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
這不算什麼大賞賜，
但總有一天你會用得上的。
關於細節，去問我計程車兵“十郎”。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Hmm, I heard that my mother
got better...but
How can I know if you cured
her or not?
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
嗯，我聽說我母親
好轉了...但是
我怎麼知道你是不是真的治好了她？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Is there any evidence to prove
that you cured her?
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
有什麼證據能證明
你治好了她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Show me the evidence to prove
your treatment. I've been
meeting so many foreigners.
But not all of them are trustworthy.
Well... Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
給我看看證明你治療過的證據。我見過
很多外國人。
但並不是所有人都值得信任。
好吧... 祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
*Chuckle* Have a good time
in Amatsu.....
Foreigners are always welcome.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
*輕笑* 祝你在櫻花城玩得愉快.....
我們永遠歡迎外國人。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
How is my mom's status?
If you find the name of the disease, please tell me.
I was worrying about
her all night.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
我母親的情況怎麼樣了？
如果你查出了病因，請告訴我。
我整夜都在擔心她。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Yoshinaga]
Because you carry with you
knowledge from Midgard,
I have faith in your ability.
scripts.translation:
[石田 義永]
因為你帶著來自米德加爾特
的知識，
我信任你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
...Huh? Why are you here...?
*Urrmmm* My head hurts...
But I'm starting to remember everything...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
...咦？你怎麼在這裡...？
*嗚...* 我頭疼...
但我開始想起所有的事了...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Thank you, traveler from a far off
land. I owe you a great debt... Thank you very much...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
謝謝你，來自遠方的旅行者。
我欠你一份大恩...非常感謝...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
I will tell my son that
you exorcised the fox...
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
我會告訴我的兒子，
是你驅除了狐狸...
謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
I should get some rest.
My head aches, Young one.....
Go to my son...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
我該去休息了。
我的頭很痛，年輕人.....
去找我的兒子吧...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Oh, Are you...? You are the one
who exorcised the fox... Welcome.
Please, have a seat...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
哦，是你...？你就是
驅除狐狸的人...歡迎。
請坐...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
When I think over, being possessed
by the fox was my fault. I raised
my son badly... Oh~
He was a good boy when he was
young. I wasn't strict to him...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
回想起來，被狐狸附身
是我的錯。是我沒教育好兒子...唉~
他小時候是個好孩子。我對他不夠嚴厲...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Long ago, this town wasn't as big
as it is today. There was no big
palace like Toukoujyo. Then, one
day, my son brought great riches
to the village. He never told me what he did to earn that fortune...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
很久以前，這個城鎮
沒有現在這麼大。也沒有像東宮城那樣的大宮殿。然後，有一天，
我的兒子給村莊帶來了巨大的財富。他從未告訴我他是如何賺到這筆財富的...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
He built the palace and helped
the towners and make the town bigger.
He was perfect until...
he started doing strange things.
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
他建造了宮殿，幫助鎮民，
讓城鎮變得更大。
他原本很完美，直到...
他開始做一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
Things...which angered God.
He learned forbidden magic,
performed experiments
in the palace, caged monsters,
did all sorts of horrible things...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
那些...惹怒了神明。
他學習了禁忌的魔法，
在宮殿裡進行實驗，囚禁魔物，
做了各種可怕的事情...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
That is the reason why there are
monsters in Toukoujyo... Finally,
God's wrath was unleashed. Even the Priest in the shrine couldn't help...
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
這就是為什麼東宮城裡
會有魔物...最終，
神明的怒火爆發了。連神龕裡的牧師也無力迴天...

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
At last, the anger came toward
me...It seems God tried to warn my son with the fox.
However, my son won't stop.
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
最後，怒火降臨到了
我身上...看來神明是想用狐狸來警告我的兒子。
然而，我的兒子並沒有停止。

scripts.text:
[Ishida Saoko]
If it is okay, please stop my son.
I don't have much time.
I don't know what to do...
Please save this peaceful village.
I beg you please...
What is he truly thinking...?
scripts.translation:
[石田 沙織子]
如果可以的話，請阻止我的兒子。
我沒有多少時間了。
我不知道該怎麼辦...
請拯救這個和平的村莊。
求求你了...
他到底在想什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
Er, I'm not really a shaman...
My friend, Takehue-kun brought
me here and invited me to try on these clothes.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
呃，我其實不是薩滿...
我的朋友竹笛把我帶到這裡，
邀請我試試這些衣服。

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
He asks me to do a lot of
weird stuff, but he is funny.
Sometimes, I don't know what
he is thinking. Still, he is a good friend.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
他讓我做很多奇怪的事情，
但他很有趣。
有時候，我不知道他在想什麼。
不過，他是個好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tokako]
If you are curious about,
something, ask Takehue-kun.
He knows stuff about
mysticism and the occult that other people don't know about.
scripts.translation:
[登香子]
如果你對某些事情好奇，
去問竹笛吧。
他知道一些關於神秘學和超自然的知識，
那是其他人所不知道的。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Eh, you are a foreigner.
I'm sure you visited me because
you are having fox troubles.
I can see that in your face.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
啊，你是外國人。
我敢肯定你來訪是因為
遇到了狐狸的麻煩。
我從你的臉上就能看出來。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Originally, the head priest should
help you, but this shrine has been
abandoned long ago.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
原本，大祭司應該
幫助你，但這座神龕
已經廢棄很久了。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
It is hard to expel a fox from
a human body. If you have liquor
and noodles with fried bean curd,
it would be easy, but they are hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
要把狐狸從人體內趕出去很難。
如果你有酒和炸豆腐面，
那就容易多了，但它們很難找到。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
I know a little about foxes, so let me tell you something...
Foxes like to tease people but
it is rare for them to crave
vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
我對狐狸瞭解一點，讓我告訴你...
狐狸喜歡捉弄人，但
它們很少渴望復仇。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
If a fox is vengeful, it means that a human caused it harm.
The fox will take its revenge
against, you, your family,
even your close friends!
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
如果一隻狐狸充滿復仇之心，
那就意味著有人傷害了它。
狐狸會對你的復仇
針對你、你的家人，
甚至你的親密朋友！

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Anyway, a stronger spirit
will expel the fox from a human.
Come on, yell out and show me your spirit!
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
總之，更強大的精靈
會將狐狸從人體內驅逐。
來吧，大聲喊叫，向我展示你的精神！

scripts.text: Taaaaah!!
scripts.translation: 嗷嗚！！

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Good. Show that spiritual
energy to the fox several times.
Sooner or later, you'll be successful.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
很好。向狐狸多次展示你的精神力量。
遲早，你會成功的。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Don't forget. You also need the
the embodiment of animals stronger
than the fox. Without these, your
concentration will be of no use.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
別忘了。你還需要比狐狸更強大的動物化身。
沒有這些，你的專注將毫無用處。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
Eh? A foreigner. This shrine
has been without priests for a
long time. My friend, Tokako and I come here to play around.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
咦？是個外國人。這座神龕
已經很久沒有牧師了。我和我的朋友登香子
來這裡玩。

scripts.text:
[Takehue]
If you have been chased by
monsters, please relax.
Monsters cannot come here, so
take a rest in here.
scripts.translation:
[竹笛]
如果你被魔物追趕，請放鬆。
魔物無法進入這裡，
所以在這裡休息一下吧。
